topics.title: Nature of motivation and the motivational cycle
topics.ncert_sections: Nature of Motivation; The Motivational Cycle

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the meaning of motivation and how motives help explain and predict behaviour.
Describe the sequence of need, drive, goal-directed behaviour and drive reduction in the motivational cycle.

topics.title: Types of motives and biological motives
topics.ncert_sections: Types of Motives; Biological Motives (Hunger, Thirst, Sex)

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish biological and psychosocial motives and explain their interdependence.
Define instinct as an inborn, biologically determined pattern of behaviour.
Explain the internal and external bases of hunger, thirst and the sex drive.
Describe the need for affiliation and McClelland's four ways of expressing the power motive.
Explain the features and sources of the need for achievement (n-Ach).
Explain curiosity and exploration as motives without a specific identifiable goal.
Arrange the five levels of Maslow's hierarchy in order and identify a need at each level.
Describe the characteristics of a self-actualised person and the limits of the hierarchy.
Distinguish emotion from feeling and mood.
Compare the six universally recognised emotions with the basic emotions proposed by Izard and Plutchik.
Explain how intensity, quality, gender and situation influence emotional experience.

topics.title: Expression of emotions and culture
topics.ncert_sections: Expression of Emotions; Culture and Emotional Expression; Culture and Emotional Labeling

concepts.learning_objective: Identify verbal and non-verbal channels of emotional expression, including paralanguage.
Explain cultural differences in gaze behaviour and emotional labeling.

topics.title: Managing negative emotions and enhancing positive emotions
topics.ncert_sections: Managing Negative Emotions; Box 8.1; Box 8.2; Managing your Anger; Enhancing Positive Emotions

concepts.learning_objective: Apply strategies such as self-monitoring, self-modeling and cognitive restructuring to manage emotions.
Distinguish monitoring and blunting strategies for examination anxiety and describe PTSD.
Explain the bases of anger management and the functions and enhancement of positive emotions.
